name: Trutnov → Polish border
about: Scenario #1. Play area = inner part of lat 50.50–50.70 N, lon 15.82–16.06 E (that box is rotated ~7° in Křovák), 17.5 × 22.5 km. Endpoints documented in PLAN.md.
frozenOverpassAbout: Original D11 caches predate query bindings. Their exact bytes are accepted by hash, never rebound or refetched; a mismatch fails instead of drifting the frozen pack.

official.about: Chain of OSM ways tagged ref=D11, highway=motorway or construction=motorway, starting at the way whose first node is nearest startNear (the first node of the southbound carriageway way 896584498 at the Polish border, where OSM switches ref D11 -> S3) and following way direction.

A.note: on official D11 (southbound carriageway) 21.0 km south of B

B.note: northern end of D11 at the Polish border (OSM ref changes D11 -> S3)
